rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; HC data from the Brain Genomics Superstruct Project (GSP), explicitly described as a large-scale, multi-site brain imaging study.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "data of 665 male participants were downloaded from the Brain Genomics Superstruct Project (GSP), a large-scale, multi-site brain imaging study (Holmes et al., 2015)"

rci5_n.detail: Training phase HC sample used to build the CT normative model via Gaussian process regression.
